dropzones.locality: Cerfontaine, Namur (near the Lacs de l'Eau d'Heure)
dropzones.status_evidence: Booking calendar shows November 2026; Instagram profile snippets show posts from March to 8 October 2026; Highfly Rodeo Festival 2026 at Skydive Cerfontaine on 23 May 2026 (Facebook event snippet).

sources.what: operator site: dropzone on the Cerfontaine aerodrome; tandem, AFF and licensed jumpers
OurAirports airport data, row EBCF, used for coordinates
tandem booking calendar, November 2026

dropzones.note: The operator's Facebook page is titled 'Skydive St-Ghislain - Cerfontaine': the Saint-Ghislain company returned to Cerfontaine in 2023 (RTBF, 17 October 2023). A 2024 dhnet.be headline about Skydive2fly returning to Cerfontaine probably refers to the same group; not confirmed. See be-saint-ghislain.

dropzones.name: Saint-Ghislain Airfield

operators.name: Skydive Saint-Ghislain (now operating as Skydive Cerfontaine)

dropzones.status_evidence: RTBF (17 October 2023): the centre opened at Saint-Ghislain in October 2022, jump altitudes were limited by skeyes, and the company moved its jumps back to Cerfontaine and to France; Saint-Ghislain awaited a decision by the authorities. No 2025+ evidence of jumps at Saint-Ghislain found. Codex cross-check found no dated resumption; remains uncertain rather than inferring closure from directory absence.

sources.what: RTBF article, 17 October 2023, on the Saint-Ghislain dropzone and the return to Cerfontaine
OurAirports airport data, row EBSG, used for coordinates
Current Walloon federation lists Spa, Cerfontaine and Namur; absence does not establish closure

dropzones.note: Probably no longer used for jumps; kept as uncertain rather than closed because no closure notice was found.

dropzones.note: Operator gives Dijkstraat, Hoevenen and a turbine aircraft; it does not name the airfield. Hoevenen airfield (EBHN, Vliegclub Hoevenen) is the only airfield there, so the link is by place. Not on the Walloon lists; found via manawa.com and a web search.
